description:
Update an existing FreeAgent expense: attach or replace its receipt, set the rebill treatment, retag the project or category, or correct the date, amount, VAT or description.

Use this to fix an expense that was filed without a receipt, or tagged to a project but never queued to rebill. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else is left alone.

RECEIPTS: PREFER filePath (a local file) or fileUrl (a download link) — the server reads and encodes it. Avoid fileBase64 for anything but tiny files. FreeAgent will not overwrite an attachment in place, so an existing receipt is deleted first and the new one replaces it.

categoryUrl.description: FreeAgent category URL to move the expense to

contentType.description: MIME type (e.g. 'application/pdf'). Inferred from the file name if omitted.

ecStatus.description: VAT treatment for the purchase (defaults to 'UK/Non-EC' when the expense was created)

expenseId.description: Numeric FreeAgent expense ID (the expenseId returned by freeagent_create_expense)

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded receipt. LAST RESORT — unreliable above a few hundred KB; prefer filePath or fileUrl.

fileName.description: File name for the receipt (e.g. 'receipt.pdf'). Defaults to the local file's name.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local receipt file (e.g. '/Users/you/Desktop/screenshot.png'). The SERVER reads and base64-encodes it — PREFER THIS over fileBase64.

fileUrl.description: URL of a receipt to download and attach. The server fetches and encodes it.

project.description: FreeAgent project URL to tag the expense against. Pass '' to remove the project tag.

rebillFactor.description: Markup percentage or fixed price — required for markup/price

rebillType.description: How to rebill this to the client — 'cost' bills it on at cost, 'markup' adds a percentage, 'price' charges a fixed price. The expense must be on a project. Pass '' to stop it being rebilled.

receiptReference.description: Supplier's own receipt or invoice number

vatRate.description: Corrected VAT rate as a percentage (e.g. '20.0')

name: freeagent_update_expense
